model: e142-state-lgbm-1.0 (risk-state; LightGBM structural level, 300 trees; phi 0.935 per quarter)
validation_status: CANDIDATE - E142 gate not passed (S1, S2, S3); validation pending; not a released forecast
claim: Forecast of the province's relative food-insecurity risk in the target quarter from a survey-anchored risk-state model: a LightGBM structural level from indicators, pulled toward the province's last measured HFIAS round with a weight that decays with the quarters since that survey (persistence estimated from measured survey-to-survey transitions). Validated survey-to-survey only (development); the quarterly transition form is an assumption and quarter-to-quarter change is NOT validated.
explanation_method: exact: TreeSHAP of the structural level by group + the decayed survey-anchor term (history)
class_rule: HIGH if P >= 0.8 and the whole model-refit range is >= 0.5; LOW if P <= 0.2 and the whole model-refit range is < 0.5; otherwise UNCERTAIN (P includes the full predictive variance)
interval_note: p_interval90 = model-refit range (30 region-bootstrap refits); relative_logit_interval90 = predictive interval of the province's relative logit (state uncertainty, grows with time since survey)
meaning: Estimated probability that the province's household food insecurity (HFIAS moderate-or-severe) is above the national level in the target quarter. A risk estimate: HIGH does not confirm food insecurity and LOW does not guarantee food security. It is not the share of food-insecure households.

Recent weather and harvests have not added pressure on local food supply.
